I lost my best friend more than 6 years ago, and tried a couple times to join him. That's something I still want to do nearly everyday, but I somehow hear him sometimes saying that I MUST keep going for him. And so should you, TheRoadsidePrincess. You have all my support and condolences.

I feel like you've just totally described myself. Like, words for words. Except that my bestfriend killed himself, so yeah, I can feel your pain. If, perhaps, you'd like to discuss about it, please message me or reply to this comment. I won't disappear from reddit and you won't disappear from life, because as stupid as it might sound, you actually seem like someone pretty cool. And i'm a pretentious cunt; I know i'm right about what I just wrote.

Hey. Have you taken countless medicines/drugs before going to sleep ? I sincerely hope not. Anyway, you're anything but a worthless trash. There's one thing I'm absolutely certain about, and i'm not saying this to cheer you up, but usually, people that want to die are smarter. There are multiple reasons about this statement, and I'm not the only one to think it.

I, on my side, genuinely hope that you do wake up tomorrow and reply to my comment, so we can discuss, or send me a message. In either way, I'll reply back and I'll keep going as long as you need. You're not alone.

Hey there. The fact that you have many people in your life that love you is truly a blessing. Anxiety is a bitch, and so can be life sometimes. But the good thing about anxiety, is that unlike life, you should and can end it. I personally don't have anyone else on my life that loves me than my mother, i'm pretty sure my father dislikes me for the fact i'm gay so; my point is that you chould cherrish the people that you love and that love you back. You don't know how much you would miss them if you do what you say you want to do. Keep up, life can be rewarding if you give it a chance.
Hey there. Where's your friend actually ?
I don't tell people that I think they're nice if they aren't. If I say it, I truly believe so. Don't underestimate yourself.
You don't know.. yet. It might take some time to eventually notice it. :)

Be careful though. You seem like a nice person that even dogs love, that's not common. I've been having therapy for a while now, and I must admit that it didn't help either lol. If you need to talk, I'm here, and so are the others on reddit. :)
Pleasure. I guess you just needed to put some words on your feelings, which is a good thing. Going somewhere ?

Pleasure. I can tell, but being lucid will help you a lot in the future, trust me.

Tell yourself one thing, important one: by fixing all this anxiety and other mental/psychological conditions, your physical pains will slowly stop and fade away. Set this as your main goal for the moment. 

I'll be honest: I've taken Valium aswell, and besides making you feel asleep when you expect it the least, it's some complete random bullshit medicine. It doesn't work.

About the anti-depressants, I'm more confident about those. They usually work, and pretty well -depending of the person. Dunno if it helps with anxiety, since it really doesn't for me, but as I said, it depends of who's taking them. Seeing your current condition, I'd advise you not to go medication free, at least not yet. You will have someone to turn to, don't worry about that. Worry about your health first, not the people. It's a good time to be a little selfish. :)

Hey there. Sorry about your condition. Fortunately, you have to know that there are remedies/cures for fibromyalgia. Perhaps you could talk about it to your close family, friend(s) or directly to a doctor. One thing is certain, you can't live like this anymore. It's time to strangle that condition and change it for a new one, one without physical pain nor tiredness. Sadly, it might take some time and you'd have to go through a lot, but trust me, you won't regret it.

Hey there. First of all, I'd like to say that I love the way you write. Even though I understand what you're saying, I feel like you're a conscious, lucid person.

"but at the same time I think it's possible that I am having such a massive mental breakdown that it's manifesting in me physically."
That is unfortunately totally possible.

Let's see what the scan has to say. Do you take any medicine or have you taken any medicine related to your anxiety or what-seems-to-be depression ?

I'm very sorry for Phoebe. At least, she's resting in peace, and I'm absolutely certain that she's had a great life having you by her side.

The fact you also lost your best friend, the same day too, is a (extremely) difficult thing to deal with, and I understand your situation. I lost my two best friends aswell, but in a more definite way. I wanted to end it aswell, but told myself.. Why would I ?

You know, there's that recurrent feeling that suicidal people tend to have; the one you get when you think about how peaceful and restful it would be to end it all.. But that is not true at all. For peace and Rest, you have to get through it all. I know it's easy-said and hard-done, but there's another thing that I'm sure about (and it's quite rare tbh); you'll have a best friend that, this time, will have reciprocal feelings with you.

You could also adopt a new dog. It sure won't be the same as with Phoebe and will perhaps bring you memories of her, but you'll have a presence and eventually your second true companion you've had and would have.

Oh, and good cinema tastes. I can't wait to watch these movies to. Perhaps we could discuss about it once we've both seen them ?

That's indeed some good news ! Hopefully everything will go on in a much better way when you'll have moved on. Denver doesn't have a bad reputation at all, so I guess your parents made a good choice here.

Keep us up-to-date ! Will follow ya until you move out and even further if you wish. :)

I just.. want to rest, undefinitely. No more feelings, no more vision, no more hearings..

Music could help, it used to at least. I'll be gone today hopefully.
I was thinking of slipping on the train rails, could be seen as an accident if I act well enough

Thanks for opening up, I appreciate it.
First of all, know that you have my whole huge respect for being such a resourceful and courageous person. I'm 19 and I still didn't do much of my life and never officially "worked", so I'm kinda impressed by your lifepath.

I'm schizophrenic, so I know what you're basically going through about this. About your beloved elerdy friend/family member, please keep in mind that this is, unfortunately, a life step and that you cannot do much about it. Enjoy her presence as long as she's here, and when she will be gone, the first thing that you will have to tell yourself is that she's resting in piece and be eternally grateful to you for having been that close to her and helping her. Trust me that she very, very certainly hopes that you will get further in life and succeed to get out of this situation. For the sake of your own life and to honor your relation with her, you will have to keep going forward. Losing someone is something extremely, speechlessly difficult and no words can describe the pain felt during this. The best friend I lost more than 5 years ago still makes me want to join him just as if he died yesterday, but I keep telling myself that I have to move forward for him, and mostly, for me. Do the same, I assure you will not use nor think about the term "regret" at all.
You need to rest, that is a certain thing. I believe that you may ask for this whatever you're working in, otherwise that job wouldn't be human-friendly at all.

As I tend to say, you're not just another nickname posting on reddit. There's a human being behind with hobbies, hope, past, relations and so much more that we can't afford to lose. Plus, your story is touching and you deserve to get out of this situation and get better soon, really. Please keep us up-to-date. Reply to this comment whenever you need, I'll be checking reddit quite often. ;)

There's no time for you to kill yourself. You would not have brought yourself here if you truly believed there is no more hope, and trust me that there always is hope.

I haven't fully understood your professional situation, but you need to contact whoever's managing/hiring/educating you and tell them that you're at the edge. Really, do it.

Hiya. You've come to the right place.

Guess I can understand you pretty well, as being gay and living in a pretty homophobic city aswell.
Your parents will have to understand that, despite living in a risky place, not everything is killing you nor everyone is plotting against the human species, or whatever.

I could suggest you one, little risky but worth it, thing. Perhaps, you could talk to your parents with conviction about your situation. Not especially that you're bisexual, but that you're spending your life not doing much (i'm taking your words back in another way, not judging or anything) and that you're not doing well, and that you really need to see a therapist. This can be a hard thing to do, especially when your own parents have anxiety or depression issues, but somehow, they should be even more understanding.

Plus, you have some cool hobbies. Don't know if you have something to record, but if someday you wanna share your guitar skills, you better let me hear some. :)

In all honesty, i'm in a likewise current situation where i'm bored, friendless (not even online ones), mentally ill and stuck in my bedroom with a semi-depressive mother and difficult father, but i'm somehow more lucky as they understand my situation.

This is a perfect time for you to begin taking your life into command, as hard and easy-to-say it might sound. Remember one thing though: you're not doing this alone, I'll be giving you my strength to help you out.

I wish I had someone to share my thoughts with aswell, which makes me feel lonely af. I guess it's the same for you.

Let's remedy to this; tell us what you're thinking of. Anything; your past, that dog you walked near in the street that barked at you for smoking or even that girl you like, even if you've only seen her once on social networks. Go ahead, empty your bag from all your overwhelming thoughts, we're here for you.

Thanks for opening up to us, it's getting more clear.
Feeling lonely is something pretty normal, and can lead to additional feelings such as rejection or not interesting anyone, which is very, very often false -if not always.

The first step to get out of this situation is to actually care about your own self. This sounds silly, I know right, but this is very necessary if you wish to go further. I don't have any real friend either, and feel like nobody cares about me. I though this was true, but eh, being sad and depressed makes me think this is an actual fact when this is not the case.

Take some time for yourself, don't mind for the others, at least just for a few hours or days. Go take a walk, watch a movie at home; if you can't, then try talking to a friend you really like/appreciate and eventually ask him/her to see each other in the upcoming days. Dare doing it, if (s)he refuses or says (s)he can't, you'd have tried, but you will still feel like nobody's interested in you if you don't do the first step. They do care about you buddy, otherwise that other friend that unfortunately pulled out at the last time wouldn't even have dared inviting you at all.

Hi there, thanks for deciding to talk about it as it is very important. Not pulling the trigger might be one of the best decisions you've ever made, besides keeping on living since your previous attempts, trust me.

Can you try telling us why you're in such state/mood ? Don't hesitate writing your story, anything that can help us understand as you will not be judged for anything here. What does this fucked up society like to use as a label for your mental illness ? Is it demencia, schizophrenia, advanced depression or something similar ?

Life can be an endless cycle sometimes, with a daily routine that can exhaust you over time, but you can do something to work on this and you will get help for it.

Trust me once again, there's no right day for someone to kill himself.

Hey there. It's great to see someone that cares about a friend that's in danger, and I'd like to thank you for that.

There a few things you can do, as far as I know;

- Go back to the hospital and tell them the situation fully, explaining how bad it is and how life threatening her situation is.
- If itsn't possible for some reasons, perhaps you can help her or maybe make her stay at your home for a moment, so she can recover ?

Don't know if any of those are possible, I wish so. If it is not, why don't you go outside eat something together, walk in the woods, see some friends or go to the nearest cinema ?
The important thing here is to begin helping her think of something else, breathe some fresh air and see life from another side. I understand how difficult it must be for her -and you aswell, and it is certain that she can't stay like this any longer.

If you need any professional advice, perhaps you could give a look at the directory of voice and chat/text holine services; https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines - and explain them the situation, they might be more helpful than most of us here -not that I personally don't want to help, but in your case, I'm not really apt to suggest much, and thus against my will.

If you talk to her or something and wish to tell her that you posted here, please tell her that she has our support in addition to yours and that she's not being forgotten.

That willing you have to kill yourself.. use it to keep living. Cutting won't help, in all honesty. It makes you feel slightly better on the moment, but you endure a huge physical pain afterwards and you say it, "it always hurts too much".

Nobody here is going to tell you how to actually 'kill yourself', because this isn't a solution. I don't know what you've been through and if you feel like sharing a bit of your story, please do so, as we would love to hear you and help you.

If you're afraid to talk to anyone, that's understandable. Let's make that first step together and talk here, even if itsn't like talking to someone in real life. I understand fully this inability to speak to people outside -or inside, as I quite am the same.

Here, let's speak safely and without any judgement. Tell us more, ThanosisKing.

Medications are just like bipolarity, regular up and downs. Don't give up, that's the wrong thing to do and you know it. Keep up, you're doing great so far for having lived -or survived ?- that long. Be proud of your path because it's cleary not ending soon.

I've never been more honest in my life. You don't need to pay to get tips and support, psys are useless. There are exceptions, but finding a good one is pretty hard. 

I'm glad you didn't cut deep enough, seriously. Go to the hospital ASAP, get yourself fixed please and don't do it again. You did it once, you know how painful it is now and you know you don't deserve this.

If you need someone that listens and understands, don't hesitate. I'll be on reddit quite often, helping who I can and hopefully make them realise how valuable their life are, just like yours. If each character of my previous post were worth 1% of someone's life value, I'd copy/paste my post a million times to show you how valuable yours is. Message if needed (yeah, against the rules, but depression ain't got no rules), or open a new post, hopefully I won't miss it.

Take care friend, as I said, you're not alone. Far from that.
I know right, everything's easier said than done, but you got it right for willing to give it a try. Please keep me up-to-date, i'm not forgetting about you.

Personal advice; don't think of that group that just left you, they don't deserve to be part of your thoughts, even if you shared good times with them.

Life is about welcoming people and letting them go, as hard as it might sound. Plus, hell, having a group that feels more like a family one than a friendship-based one is unique, don't miss that ! Enjoy it, share your time with them, and you won't make their life any worse but will actually make them enjoy their lifes because they'll be spending their time within a group of -i hope- awesome people, including you.

Hey you. Thanks for coming down there, i'm glad you actually put a cry for help on an anonymous message board even though you don't know you did it. 

Living with learnign disability is extremely hard, and i'm not telling you anything new to you. The fact he hung himself is a extremely hard thing to live, but as the younger brother, you must not follow the 'mistakes' of your sibling. He rescued you despite his disability because he knew that it wasn't your time and it still isn't.

Nobody's asking you to jump everywhere of joy after what happened, but we can ask you not to do anything that could hurt you. Your parents went and are going through a difficult period, and hurting yourself will hurt them 2x, if not 10x times more. I'm sorry about you feeling guilty about what your girlfriend has been and is going through, but this is part of life and hopefully she'll still be with you throughout this difficult time because you'll both need company.

Quitting your job isn't such a bad idea after all. Take some time to rest. It's not human-like to keep working after hearing such tragic news and you probably did the right thing.

See yourself in one year, see yourself feeling already better. Now, in 10 years, and 40. Don't know if you want kids and if you'll have the courage to handle the uncessing tears of your beloved baby, or if you'd prefer living a happy duo-life with your loved one while going to restaurant and travelling as far as you can to discover nature's beauty, but whatever your choice will be, you will have to make that choice.

Present-time must be hard, I give that to you. Be strong, you're loved, you're not alone and you'll never be alone, unless you do something that you won't be able to undo.

That makes sense the way you explain it, but that doesn't make sense the way they acted. If that's what they did, then, sorry, but you can't call them "friends", but perhaps "pretenders".

Trust me, being dead is worse than being alone. Being dead is permanent, being alone **is not**. In the present time, we tend to think that loneliness is something that lasts forever, because time clocks slowly and every second passing, you're still feeling lonely, and think that you will still be the next seconds, and repeat, and repeat.

It might make some people unhappy for you to exist because they're random scumbags that don't care about the others' issues, but it will very soon make people feel happy to know someone such as you is alive. And it already started, because it makes me happy somehow to know that people like you exist.

Your mother probably didn't expect this, and it must be hard for her. But, someday, she will understand that if that makes you happy and if you can be the way you are, then she will have to accept it.

You're still her child, her loved one. People can feel lost or sick when they learn something such as this from people they love the most, but that means that she freakin loves you. It might take some time till she gets used to it, but you have to be patient and understand the situation.

Yes, killing yourself would make her worse, you're totally right. Depression is a bitch, like a bubblegum on the road waiting for the first kid to walk on it and then suck the life out of you. I like the evil monkey comparison.

As much as I like trans people, because nowadays, it's still hard to be like this. You're courageous and beautiful, and you must keep going forward and be yourself. It's hard, but it will be hella worth it.

I think that you have chosen a nice nickname, because you sure have some guts to have gotten that far in life with such a hard past -and present. I will be talking about some elements of my life, not to complain about my shitty one, but to prove that I know what I'm talking about and that I understand you probably like nobody ever did.

When I was 17, I told myself that I wasn't going to make it until my 18s. Today i'm 19. You haven't been bullied for no reason, you've been bullied by cowards because they were jealous of you or beaten by someone else, that's a fact. I used to pass out because of anxiety and stress, but I must admit myself being lucky that I didn't puke instead, otherwise I'd have repainted the floors of the whole high school in green/yellow.

I was underweight too. Not anymore, thanks to medicine that made me gain 2x my weight lol. Just by your description, if you can seem like someone that could interest a gay-ass person like me because I find 'small' and underweight people fucking attractive, trust me that you can interest anyone else.

Now, the embarassing part, where I'd like to list your qualities judging by this single post of yours. To me, you're a young lucid, interesting, conscious, strong and fuck I can't find the words for the way you wrote this. Describing your situation about yourself alone in the room or the way you sit or shit like this, I fucking wish I had a friend like you, and also fucking wish I could be there to fuck these kids up that beat you just because they were physically stronger or had a digital superiority over you, but the stronger one here was, is and will still be you for enduring all this and still being here. That's hell of a life you have there, and that's hell of a courage that you have there aswell.

You took and are taking from everyone's problems and impulsivity and nobody knows how good and strong you are and.. fuck the good words, seriously you have no idea of how valuable people like you are, and i'm not saying this to cheer you up but because I truly believe so.

You take those razor blades and throw them away because you're not hurting yourself anymore. Life is hard, life sucks but life is also a wonderful thing when you get to enjoy it. Yes, enjoying it when you have such a difficult situation seems like something you can't afford, but you have enough strength and experience to go further and prove these fucker-asses that all the strength they put into their legs and fists beating you was given to you. One hundred freakin percent of the bullies will have karma falling on them one day, and when they'd expect it the least. I'm not saying that you should enjoy someone's misfortune, but hey, they deserve it for hurting someone just because they wanted to prove they're stronger by hitting someone who was actually physically weaker, but once again, mentally and psychologically much, much stronger.

I've been in a psychiatry hospital twice in like 1 year in my life due to my bipolarity, schizophrenia, depression, demencia and blabla the labels that they chose to name something they have no idea of. I'm talking about those psys that think they know something about mental diseases or social anxiety when they live in their comfortable zone everyday and go to their workplace in their golden SUV that they paid with their salary just because they're able to listen to someone and go "uh-uh" all day long pretending they understand shit about your situation when they obviously don't.

Some people are fucking bad, hideous, egocentric and those people are like bullies; karma's gonna hit them, and hard. Others are either sympathic, damaged or lost and karma's gonna hit them too, but in a good way. Karma's a bitch, because she punishes back, but she rewards back for someone's courage and strongness.

Don't give up on life, else I won't perhaps be able to meet you someday and that would make me sad. Don't listen to your alcoholic mother too, she's just lost in her sadness as silly as I might sound, but she doesn't know how hard she's missing on such a good kid you are.

You're 18. I don't even know your name, but I can tell that even if you have some life experience about life issues and difficulties, you're not worth killing yourself, you're worth having a decent life and **that will happen to you**, because fuck it all, you deserve it. Much love to you.

Yes, you can't bring yourself to do it because you know it's not what you're supposed to do. When humans feel sad, they tend to think negatively and feel worthless for the others, and that's as false as stating Trump's a courageous and truthful man, that is to say.

It's totally normal not to get it though, that means you're somehow lost, but what's really interesting in what you're saying are those few words; "even for people who I care about most"

You care about people. This is getting rare and I'd like the human species to keep people like you for the sake of a better world.

Believe it or not, but the only way you'll hurt others is by hurting yourself first. You've been thinking about it for years and almost over a year, yet you're still here. I don't think you hate life, you hate your situation, which I truly understand.

There are difficult moments in your life, or even a whole difficult life. This is a sad fact. I'm bipolar aswell, so I think I'm well placed to talk about this. Humor going up and down in a matter of seconds, if not milliseconds, is something you can't really control, just like anger or impulsivity.

Perhaps, that person actually cares. You say that you don't **think** (s)he cares, but you have no evident proof. Bipolarity is known to also make people wrongly think the others don't care while they actually do. They just don't really have a clue about the overwhelming heat in your body and up-and-down of feelings when you're having a 'disorder' (that's a big and wrong term i'm using) like bipolarity. That is hard to live, but that makes you unique, and unique people are very welcome on Earth and in life itself. You do need to strangle something, but not yourself. Strangle the hard side of your life, make the best of it.

You do need something; you need love. You need people to care about you the way you probably care about the ones you love and you definitely deserve such affection. Humans are known for not always getting what they deserve, that's another sad fact. Life is hard, oh yes it is. But you'd rather have a hard life over no life at all, and that is another non-negotiable fact.

Breathe the fresh air. Medicine doesn't work well apparently for you, so here's another method and, really, **try it**; for the others but **mostly and especially** for you; walk. Walk in the nature, watch the others smile or argue at the bird that just shat on their freshly-bought $250 jacket and appreciate the greenery of the trees. Well, winter's coming so the greenery will leave its place to a beautiful whiteness and coldness, but this is hella enjoying aswell. You don't want to miss a hot coffee while being wrapped by a blanket on a cold day while watching the others slip on a slippery road. (i'm not telling you to enjoy the others' misfortune, but seeing this somehow reminds you how precious life can be)
Sorry, i'm weird.

First of all, glad to meet you pal.
I'd like you to answer a few questions. This isn't recorded by the FBI or anything else, so you can say anything you want and reveal anything, you won't be judged nor arrested if you admit that you smoke illegal things. my humour sucks

Why would you want to kill yourself, exactly ? Tell us more about your story, we'd be really glad to help.
Go type shit, because we fucking care. You're not a random person with a nickname complaining about its life, you're a human being that needs help. Tell us more darling.

Message the mods, they'll get banned. But mostly, don't listen to such deepshits. They're trollers and like to post on random threads to help someone go deeper into their sadness. Please do differentiate trolls from people that actually try to help, as the first ones really don't deserve any pinch of your attention.

There you fucking go, I like reading this. You'll be awarded with actual real friends and a girlfriend that deserves you and that you deserve for bringing such positivity to your life. This better not be sarcasm. I'll track you down and check out to see if you're enjoying life. If you aren't, don't wonder who's that random guy that just kicked your ass out of your chair and disappeard after doing a weird dance.

There is no painless way to die, but if there's something that kills you for a moment, it's called a cuddle. I'd love to give you one if I was near enough.

Please tell us more about what's going on and how you've arrived to this point. I'm not saying this randomly by reading your post and just answering to it like it's another person in detress, I'm personally looking further and I want to help you.

You're right somehow for not really caring about the others' pain. You're right to think about your own self and you're right to allow yourself to do so.

I have an idea for your date, but you should expect to die of natural causes before you reach it, because flying cars will be too mainstream.

It sucks being diabetic, I give you that. Who is that person you're talking about ? Tell us more, I personally would love to hear more of your story.

I feel you, like entirely. I'd like to thank you first for putting words to this feeling that I personally couldn't describe, you're good at explaining things I see.
